title: Add global loading/error UI components and apply spacing/consistency polish across the app

requirements.text: Create a single, reusable global UI pattern for loading states (spinner/skeleton + message) and apply it consistently across the app screens, replacing ad-hoc loading UI (e.g., AuthGate full-screen loader and page-level loaders such as LeaderboardPage).
acceptanceCriteria: A shared loading component (or small set of shared components for full-page vs. inline loading) exists in the frontend codebase and is used by the main app authentication/loading gate and the primary pages.
Loading UI uses consistent styling (typography, spacing, spinner sizing/colors) across all locations where it appears.
No user-facing loading text is left inconsistent (e.g., a mix of 'Loading...' and differently styled loading labels) unless intentionally parameterized via props.

requirements.text: Create a single, reusable global UI pattern for error states (icon/title/message + optional retry action) and apply it consistently across the app screens and data-fetching components, replacing ad-hoc error messages (e.g., inline destructive text blocks) with the global pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: A shared error component exists and supports at least: title, message, and an optional retry callback.
At least the main pages and key data components that currently render errors (e.g., match history) use the shared error UI.
User-facing error text is in English and follows a consistent tone and structure across the app.

requirements.text: Perform an app-wide UI spacing and consistency pass across all pages and common layouts to achieve a more polished, uniform look (headers, max-width containers, section spacing, card padding, and button alignment), while keeping existing functionality unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: All top-level pages use a consistent page wrapper approach (consistent max width, horizontal padding behavior, and vertical spacing between sections).
Headings and icon+heading rows (e.g., 'Calendar', 'Leaderboard', 'Profile') follow consistent sizing, spacing, and alignment across pages.
Card sections (CardHeader/CardContent) and common interactive rows use consistent padding and gap spacing across pages.
No functionality regressions: navigation, forms, leaderboard actions, chat, and profile flows still work as before.

constraints: Do not implement or change empty states (the user explicitly opted out of empty state work).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only and must be composed rather than modified).
Do not edit immutable hook entry points listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep backend unchanged unless strictly required for UI polish (no new backend features are part of this request).
nonGoals: Adding onboarding, settings, FAQ/help, analytics, or new product features.
Changing leaderboard ranking logic or adding new leaderboard features.
Reworking app branding, PWA behavior, or offline/service-worker logic beyond what is necessary to standardize loading/error presentation.
